extension.summary: Convert sports odds and see the bookmaker margin
extension.description: Type a price in American (-110, +150), decimal (1.91) or fractional (5/2) format and see it in every format with its implied probability. Enter every price in a market to see the bookmaker margin and the fair, no-margin chance of each outcome. Works offline: no network access and no data collected.
extension.disclaimer: For information only. Implied probabilities come from the prices you enter.
extension.news: v1.0.0 (2026-11-07) - First release: odds conversion, implied probability, market margin and fair chances
